title: Neon Snake
description: Navigate a glowing cyber serpent through the neon grid, gobbling energy orbs and avoiding self-collision.
controls: Arrow keys or WASD to turn

title: 2048 Neon Edition
description: Slide matching numbered tiles across the 4x4 matrix to combine them into the legendary 2048 block.
controls: Arrow keys or Swipe on mobile
Undo button to revert last move

title: Asteroids Space Blaster
description: Pilot your starfighter through deep space, rotating 360 degrees and blasting dangerous asteroids into fragments.
controls: W or Up to engage thrust

title: Brick Breaker Deluxe
description: Ricochet the energy sphere off your shield paddle to shatter colorful brick formations and clear stages.
controls: Mouse or Touch to move paddle
Click or Space to launch ball

title: Pong Championship
description: The quintessential arcade duel! Challenge the AI opponent or invite a friend for 2-player local battle.

title: Flappy Retro
description: Test your timing and nerves by flapping through a continuous obstacle course of conduit pipes.
controls: Spacebar or Tap to flap wings

title: Tetris Matrix
description: Standard SRS rotation falling tetrominoes with ghost guide, soft drop, and instant hard drop line clearing.

title: Minesweeper Sweeper
description: Uncover grid cells using numerical clues to locate hidden charges without triggering any mines.
controls: Left Click to reveal safe tile
Right Click to plant warning flag (🚩)

title: Tower Stack Master
description: Place sliding platforms exactly on top of previous blocks to construct an endlessly soaring skyscraper.
controls: Spacebar or Tap to drop block

title: Cyber Reactor Clicker
description: Harvest raw quantum energy by clicking the core, and automate production with nano-bots and colliders.
controls: Click or tap core to harvest

title: Tic Tac Toe Neon Pro
description: Play the clean minimalist neon grid against an AI opponent or in 2-player hotseat mode.
controls: Get 3 in a row to win

title: Doodle Sky Jumper
description: Bounce upon hovering neon platforms, moving pads, and springs to reach astronomical heights.
